'''Candor Six Six Twelve''' was an old [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. The [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Stoneheart]] chose Candor Six Six Twelve to transport its primary command module to the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]].<ref name="Game" />
